sn22.100:1.3: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaññojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
sn22.100:1.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave sā gaddūlabandho daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā upanibandho so gacchati cepi tameva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upagacchati tiṭṭhati cepi tameva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upatiṭṭhati nisīdati cepi tameva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upanisīdati nipajjati cepi tameva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upanipajjati.
sn22.100:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano rūpaṃ etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupassati
sn22.100:1.9: viññāṇaṃ etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupassati.
sn22.100:1.10: so gacchati cepi imeva pañcupādānakkhandhe upagacchati
sn22.100:1.14: tasmā tiha bhikkhave abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
sn22.100:1.15: dīgharattamidaṃ cittaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenāti.
sn22.100:2.3: tampi kho bhikkhave caraṇaṃ nāma cittaṃ citteneva cintitaṃ. tenapi kho bhikkhave caraṇena cittena cittaññeva cittataraṃ.
sn22.100:2.4: tasmā tiha bhikkhave abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
sn22.100:2.5: dīgharattamidaṃ cittaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenāti.
sn22.100:3.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekanikāyaṃpi samanupassāmi evaṃ cittaṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave tiracchānagatā pāṇā.
sn22.100:3.2: tepi kho bhikkhave tiracchānagatā pāṇā citteneva cintitā. tehipi kho bhikkhave tiracchānagatehi pāṇehi cittaññeva cittataraṃ.
sn22.100:3.3: tasmā tiha bhikkhave abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
sn22.100:3.4: dīgharattamidaṃ cittaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenāti.
sn22.100:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rajako vā cittakārako vā sati rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīlāya vā mañjeṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭe vā phalake bhittiyā vā dussapaṭe vā itthīrūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ.
sn22.100:4.2: evaṃ kho bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano rūpaññeva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti vedanaññeva. saññaññeva. saṅkhāre yeva. viññāṇaññeva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti.
sn22.100:4.9: viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti. aniccaṃ bhante.
